compiledPathwayPreserved.summary: West Virginia juvenile proceeding records are generally not public records. One year after the juveniles 18th birthday, or one year after personal or juvenile jurisdiction ends, whichever is later, juvenile records may be kept in a separate secure confidential place and may not be inspected except by circuit court order. Marking juvenile records confidential has the legal effect of extinguishing the offense as if it never occurred. compiledPathwayPreserved.label: Sex-trafficking-victim vacatur and expungement
compiledPathwayPreserved.summary: A person convicted of prostitution, or adjudicated delinquent, as a direct result of being a trafficking victim may petition the circuit court in the county of conviction or juvenile adjudication to vacate the conviction/adjudication and expunge the record. The court may grant relief if it finds the persons participation in the offense was a direct result of being trafficked. No rehabilitation requirement is imposed for this trafficking-victim expungement route.
